external_lineage.mechanism: SPLIT4-inspired four-wave-per-output scheduling; G1A isolated physical coordination while retaining one output per workgroup

hardware.role: independent GPU1 screening lane; no W7900 measurement

software.candidate_state: uncommitted isolated kernel atop base commit; removed after stop gate

comparison.control: registered linear_pair/f32/bf16_hidden_bf16_out: one local256 workgroup per output, 96 workgroups per alpha/beta pair
comparison.candidate: temporary linear_pair/f32/bf16_hidden_bf16_out_virtual256_local128: one local128 workgroup per output, 96 workgroups per pair
comparison.candidate_arithmetic: 128 physical threads emulate the exact 256 parent partitions; acc_lo+acc_hi reproduces s=128, then LDS/shuffle reproduces s=64..1
comparison.counterbalance: 15 AB/BA alternating pairs per cache regime after three warmup arms
comparison.timing: HIP event elapsed time around each complete launch sequence
comparison.g1b_reason: G1A lost all 45 paired comparisons, including the 90 MiB real-weight rotation; the campaign required a credible G1A premise before halving workgroups with two-output SPLIT4

correctness.red: 3 focused tests failed before the G1A symbol, wrapper, and registry variant existed
correctness.transient_green: 11 passed in tests/test_dense_f32_pair.py on HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1, including rows1-4 scalar/pair/G1A BF16-bit exactness and CPU KL/top-1 floors

hot.cache_class: one 1.875 MiB alpha/beta pair repeated 256 times
hot.interpretation: algorithmic cache-hot bandwidth, not physical DRAM traffic

rotating.cache_class: all 48 immutable alpha/beta pairs (90 MiB) in model order, repeated four times

cache_thrashed.cache_class: synchronous 128 MiB hipMemset before one 90 MiB rotation; thrash excluded from event timing

kernel_trace.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-file g1a --output-directory /tmp/gfx1100-gemv-g1a-rocprof -- python3 <temporary-probe> --require-cached-build --pairs 1 --warmups 0 --modes cold

commands.focused_gate: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_dense_f32_pair.py --tb=short

decision.reason: The exact local128/virtual256 schedule loses every paired comparison in all three cache regimes. It lowers LDS and physical threads without lowering VGPR allocation, but serializes two parent partitions per thread; the real 90 MiB rotation is 16.27% slower by median elapsed time. The G1 stop gate fires before two-output packing or W7900 work.
decision.fallback: unchanged registered local256 pair and two singleton dense-F32 projections
decision.reopen_condition: A future candidate needs a different premise that preserves enough grid/memory-level parallelism; do not repeat local128 virtual-partition serialization or infer a win from Qingming's FP32/FP32 SPLIT4 threshold.
